system.description: Calligrapher procedure. Draws Iyutha's sigils on a willing recipient in Malfean vitriol. At a later time the recipient invokes the magic through Iyutha's name, causing a rain of acid (three yards wide, 15 ticks) targeting any visible point within (Essence × 50) yards. Each use gains the recipient one level of Obsession Derangement or one mutation point toward demonic features. Must be discharged within a month or Iyutha discharges it on the recipient.
